title: Squares
summary: Know the squares to $15^2$ by heart, square any number ending in $5$ in one step, step from one square to the next, and build the squares from $16^2$ to $30^2$ from a round number.
bigIdeas: A square number is a number times itself: $7^2 = 7 \times 7 = 49$.
Squares follow patterns, so you can build new squares from ones you know.
tips: Ending in $5$: times the tens digit by the next number up, then write $25$. $35^2$: $3 \times 4 = 12$, so $1225$.
Squares only end in $0$, $1$, $4$, $5$, $6$ or $9$. A number ending in $7$ is never a square.
